name: @dsh-external/dsh-attack-atlas
description: AttackAtlas tab for the eight specialist security presets: per-mode architecture matrix (battle zones x tactics x items with per-mode terminal-state semantics), four-state coverage light-up, dispatch-on-double-click, attack-chain topology, custom work-methodology composer (layered run envelope, closure inquiry), tool/MCP/custom-tool modules with install-approval protocol, and a capability library of user-defined categories and items shared into the composer. v1.2.0 made the target a first-class dimension of the coverage ledger: coverage cells, stage bands and chain topology are accounted per target (same cell keeps independent terminal states per target), with an active-target pointer (first registered target auto-activates; redteam_atlas_target switch re-anchors; writes default to the active target), a per-target/aggregate matrix view, and org (organization) as a target kind. v1.2.1 selects the working target from a dropdown (selecting re-anchors and routes dispatches/default writes to it; a persistent badge shows the active anchor), and adds the LLM output-downstream-parsing cell (jailbreak only becomes a traditional vuln when the server re-parses model output into deserialization/SSTI/command sinks; pure-text-model targets have no such bridge). Legacy stores migrate automatically (single-target sessions attributed, multi-target rows kept in the session-common scope; *_legacy tables retained).
author: SeaOf0
